It’s so interesting how if someone tries a casino site and loses in their first session with an incredibly small volume done and even smaller sample size of bets that the immediate conclusion is that the casino is rigged.  

Very confused why players think this way.  

How exactly is rigging the games to completely obliterate and nuke the player population a sustainable business model?

The LTV of a player is so much more incredibly valuable over a long duration vs straight down nuke instant loss terrible experience.  

The casino isn’t rigging games to make you lose faster.  The casino has a built in edge and you will lose no matter what over time because of that edge.  

The casinos goal is to have a fun environment and provide entertainment for the lifetime of the user and grow the community while promoting gambling responsibly. 

Why the hell would the casinos goal be to obliterate and zero you immediately?  Trust me when I say that is the dumbest low IQ narrative I see out here on X.  

Losing sucks, losing fast and instantly sucks worse, but there is no world where RTP is being rigged on games that ALREADY HAVE AN EDGE.
